fields.label: Sync with Google Drive
fields.description: Off until the bench has MCFT_GDRIVE_SA_JSON and the folder ids below.

fields.label: Handover Folder ID
fields.description: The folder ERPNext WRITES faces into. Must be in a shared drive: a service account has no storage of its own, so writing into a My Drive folder fails on quota.

fields.label: ImageMeter Upload Folder ID
fields.description: ImageMeter's image-upload directory, READ ONLY. Never write here — ImageMeter manages its own sync data.

fields.options: Find a folder id in its Drive URL: drive.google.com/drive/folders/<id>. Share the handover folder with the service account as Content manager and the ImageMeter folder as Viewer.

fields.label: Only Queue Files Modified After
fields.description: ImageMeter's folder holds years of unrelated photos. Anything older than this is not a reply to a handover, so it is never queued for review. Set automatically on the first sync; clear it to re-consider everything.

fields.label: Android Package Name
fields.description: e.g. com.malletcrafts.sitephotos — must match the app on Play.

fields.label: Signing SHA-256 Fingerprints
fields.description: One per line. Take Play's App Signing certificate fingerprint AND your upload certificate's — an app signed by Play shows the browser bar unless BOTH are listed.

fields.options: These publish /.well-known/assetlinks.json, which is how Android proves this app owns this site and hides the URL bar. Chrome fetches it anonymously and caches it — get it right before the first release.

fields.label: Last Sync Error
fields.description: Why the last run failed. Cleared by the next run that succeeds — a stale error beside a fresh last_sync is its own kind of lie.
